target.title: fix(tlon): add timeouts to file upload HTTP requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`uploadFile` in `extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.ts` makes three outbound HTTP requests via `fetchWithSsrFGuard` without a `timeoutMs`: the Memex upload URL lookup, the Memex upload PUT, and the custom S3 signed-URL PUT. Without explicit timeouts, stalled servers can hang the request indefinitely, matching the class of issues fixed in #102027, #102025, #102050.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add named constants and forward `timeoutMs` to all three `fetchWithSsrFGuard` calls so upload operations fail fast and release resources.

## User Impact

File uploads to Tlon time out predictably instead of hanging.

## Evidence

### Unit tests

```bash
pnpm test extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.test.ts --run
```

Result: `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 15 passed (15)`.

The existing tests now assert that the Memex URL lookup receives `timeoutMs: 30_000` and both upload PUT paths receive `timeoutMs: 120_000`.

### Loopback timeout proof

A local `node:http` server accepts the TCP connection and never responds. `fetchWithSsrFGuard` rejects within `timeoutMs + 2s` when `timeoutMs: 500`:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.timeout-loopback.test.ts --run
```

Output:

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (1)
   Start at  23:11:47
   Duration  1.34s
```

(The temporary loopback test file was removed before commit; the output above is preserved as proof.)

## Real behavior proof

- **Label:** timeout
- **Surface:** `extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.ts`
- **Behavior:** `getMemexUploadUrl` and both upload `fetchWithSsrFGuard` calls now include `timeoutMs`.
- **Command run:** `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/tlon/src/tlon-api.timeout-loopback.test.ts --run`
- **Exact output:** `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 1 passed (1) / Duration ~1.3s`
- **Head SHA:** `cb03d5b8c84542d9aadab6ea8494191a821578a0`
- **Environment:** Linux, Node 22.19, local checkout
- **Observed result:** The guarded fetch against a hanging loopback server rejected within `timeoutMs + 2s` with `timeoutMs: 500`.
- **What was not tested:** Live Tlon/Memex/custom-S3 endpoint (no live credentials).

AI-assisted: This PR was prepared with AI assistance.
